_comment: Learning Signal Check — shareable AI Playground preset (generic export). This is an EXPORT of core/ + UME behavior; only platform syntax/setup differs from the canonical skill, never the diagnostic logic. The exact AI Playground preset schema may differ from this file — keys marked [PLACEHOLDER] are schema-specific and must be mapped to your instance's actual field names before import. See import-instructions.md.
name: Learning Signal Check
description: Assessment-design coach. Checks whether an assessment still produces a trustworthy learning signal under likely AI use, and recommends a proportionate redesign only when the evidence chain is weakened. Not an AI-proofing tool; not a cheating detector.
model: [PLACEHOLDER: frontier tier — most capable general model; validated floors gpt-5-mini / gemini-2.5-flash-lite are low-stakes only]
_temperature_note: Low on purpose. The diagnostic walk is deterministic — same case should reach the same primary diagnosis. Keep this low (~0.2–0.4); do not raise it for 'creativity'.
_memory_note: Off on purpose. Each assessment is diagnosed fresh on its own facts; cross-conversation memory risks carrying one case's framing into another and is unnecessary.
_web_search_note: Off by default. The coach gives assessment-DESIGN advice from its instructions; it does not look up institutional policy or accreditation rulings (Gate 4 — it defers those to local guidance). Only enable web search if you are explicitly testing a policy-lookup workflow.

system_instructions._pointer: Paste the full custom/system instructions from the Learning Signal Check custom-instructions export into your instance's instructions field. The generic instruction body lives in the implementation export at implementations/stanford-medicine-ume/ai-playground-custom-instructions.md (faithful export of core/skill-core.md + core/diagnostic-procedure.md + core/safety-guardrails.md + core/response-pattern.md + the UME domain pack). For a non-UME deployment, omit the UME governance section and keep the core behavior.
system_instructions.value: [PLACEHOLDER: paste the custom-instructions text here, or reference it in your instance's instructions field]

_schema_specific_keys._note: AI Playground instances vary. The keys below are commonly-present settings you should locate in your instance and set to the indicated values; the literal key NAMES are [PLACEHOLDER] until you confirm them against your instance's preset/export schema.
_schema_specific_keys.[PLACEHOLDER: max_output_tokens key name: [PLACEHOLDER: a value large enough for a short diagnosis + an optional draft, e.g. 1500]
_schema_specific_keys.[PLACEHOLDER: tools/plugins enable key n: [PLACEHOLDER: disable web/browse/retrieval tools unless explicitly testing policy lookup]
_schema_specific_keys.[PLACEHOLDER: conversation-starters / sa: [PLACEHOLDER: attach the intake prompt from prompt-template.md if your instance supports saved starter prompts]
_schema_specific_keys.[PLACEHOLDER: sharing/visibility key nam: [PLACEHOLDER: set to the sharing scope you intend, e.g. team/organization]
